history.change: Mugar Omni Theater opened at the Museum of Science, Boston. Named after David G. Mugar. One of the largest IMAX Dome installations in the Northeast.

metadata.notes: Institutional IMAX Dome. Dome screen diameter is 23.20 m (76.1 ft) per 143190.xyz CSV (r_imax_csv). ArcGIS lists 72 ft (~21.9 m); the discrepancy reflects screen-surface measurement vs. structural-shell measurement — using 143190's 23.20 m. Current LIEMAX model treats Mugar as post-2021 digital IMAX Dome laser, not active 15/70 film. FOV values (180° H × 125° V, 83% hemisphere coverage) are standard IMAX Dome architecture — venue-specific measurements not separately confirmed.
